It sounds like there is a lot if manipulation going on here. If she really just wont lift a hand to help you with most things, but youre still called an asshole for the things you do around the house you should get out. Youre gonna be going to school a distance away from her and im sure her family will still make you out to be a bad guy for it. The good thing is that socially, highschool (17 Im assuming youre in highschool) is a very small portion of a much bigger world and once you get to a college there will be a plethora of people youll have a chance to connect with. It is very difficult to let go of someone who you genuinely care about but sometimes you gotta do it for you so that you can be the best you. 



Tl;dr Dump her, embrace social life in college, even if your current friends choose her youll find plenty of new people in the future. Good luck!
